summary: Tested the casual meetup check-in and the guest picker on guild and casual check-ins. Backend: the new test_iteration9_casual_guests.py passes 8 of 8. Regressions also pass: iteration 8 (11/11), iteration 7 (12/12) and iteration 4 (14/14). Checked in the backend: POST /api/checkin/casual is free for non-subscribers and subscribers, returns 401 when logged out, and works with no body. A same-day duplicate returns 400. Kids and support workers are stored in family with their kinds. An unknown or aged-out family id returns 400 and creates no row. The dashboard returns casual_checkin_today. It does not change checked_in_today, attendance, door value or second_session_free. A non-subscriber's main check-in still returns 402. A subscriber can do both casual and main check-ins, and only the main one counts toward attendance and $5 door value. A casual check-in does not trigger paid_earlier, but a real paid check-in still does. Admin check-ins show a 'casual' group labelled 'Casual meetup (unofficial)' with guests counted, and the main headcount covers day and evening only. In /api/admin/summary, new_checkins shows via=casual with family_count, and checkins_today leaves out casual and guild. Casual dates show up in checkin-dates, reminders and bonus missing_dates, and an at_meetup log is accepted. Guild check-ins store de-duplicated family_ids, a non-member still gets 403, and a bad family id returns 400. A deleted guild's label now falls back to the stored guild_name. UI (desktop, plus mobile at 390px): the card shows both groups of guests. Ticking guests then pressing casual-checkin-button shows casual-checkin-done, and the guests were saved in the DB. The guild button with one kid ticked saved that kid. checkin-pay-button still reads 'Check in & pay $5' and is enabled. Account history shows 'Casual meetup' / 'Free'. The admin toast read 'TEST uicas checked in · Casual meetup + 1 free guest'. The admin Check-ins tab shows the casual group (3 people, with kid and support lines and 'Casual · free') and the guild group with its guest. The count reads '0 people at main sessions'. In the log dialog, the meetup switch is enabled and ON for today after a casual-only check-in. No functional bugs found.

ui_bugs.issue: Duplicate data-testids: both cards render checkin-family-picker and checkin-family-<id>, so the page has 2 of each. Tests must scope by card. Consider prefixing the ones in GuildCheckInCard (e.g. meetup-family-<id>).

issues: The guest picker stays visible after the casual and all guild check-ins are done. Hide it when nothing is left to check in to.
After a guild or casual check-in, the card doesn't show which guests came along. The main card shows a 'With …' line.
One shared 'picked' state is used for every row, so the guests you tick apply to whichever button you press next. That is acceptable, but it is not obvious.

action_items: Optional: give the meetup card's guest checkboxes their own testids (avoid duplicates with CheckInCard)
Optional: hide the guest picker in GuildCheckInCard once all rows are checked in, and show the guests who came with each done row
critical_code_review_comments: Abuse vector: a casual check-in is free, needs no membership and has no host confirmation. Any registered account can now earn the 2-month raffle bonus (BONUS_ENTRIES) by checking in casual once in a block and logging one at_meetup game; qualifies = bool(dates) and not missing. Before this change, a bonus needed a paid or subscriber check-in, or guild membership. Consider leaving casual-only check-ins out of period_progress, requiring at least one official check-in per block, or adding host approval.
Casual check-ins are limited to one per slot date (session='casual'), so a casual meetup after 5am the next day is a new date. This is fine.
The admin_checkins guild label fallback now uses r.get('guild_name'), so the iteration 8 minor issue is fixed. The DELETE guild member route now returns 404, so that issue is fixed too.
seed_data_creation: Only TEST_ users and TEST_ guilds were created, and all were removed afterwards: TEST_ users 0, checkins 0, test login_attempts 0, and the UI admin session was deleted. Two real guilds (MITHRIL, BLAZING) existed before testing started. They were created at 11:22 UTC by the real admin and were left untouched. The 2 game_logs belong to the real admin. Real users were never checked in or modified. No Square links or payments were made.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend/tests && python -m pytest test_iteration9_casual_guests.py -p no:xdist -o addopts=''. For the UI: python ui_seed_iter9.py setup creates a non-subscriber with a kid and a support worker in a TEST_ guild, and writes the tokens to /tmp/ui_iter9.json. Then run 'python ui_seed_iter9.py cleanup'. Scope checkbox selectors inside [data-testid=guild-checkin-card], because testids are duplicated. The admin toast polls every 20s and sonner toasts disappear after about 4s, so poll for [data-sonner-toast] in a loop. The real guilds MITHRIL and BLAZING now exist and include the real users; do not delete them.
